name: CircleCI
description: Protects against destructive CircleCI operations like deleting contexts, \ removing secrets, deleting orbs/namespaces, or removing pipelines.

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-context-delete
destructive_patterns.description: circleci context delete removes contexts and their secrets.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a CircleCI context removes all secrets stored within it. Any pipeline \ jobs that reference this context will fail immediately. Secret values cannot be \ recovered after deletion and must be manually re-entered.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - circleci context list: Review contexts before deletion \ - circleci context show: Inspect context secrets (names only) \ - Document secret names before removing context

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-context-remove-secret
destructive_patterns.description: circleci context remove-secret deletes secrets from a context.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Removing a secret from a context makes it unavailable to all jobs using that \ context. Pipelines depending on this secret will fail. The secret value cannot \ be retrieved after removal.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - circleci context show: Review secrets in context first \ - Update the secret value instead of removing \ - Document secret value externally before removal

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-orb-delete
destructive_patterns.description: circleci orb delete removes an orb from the registry.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an orb removes it from the CircleCI orb registry. Any pipeline using \ this orb will fail on the next run. If other teams or projects depend on this \ orb, their CI/CD will break without warning.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - circleci orb info: Review orb details and usage \ - Deprecate the orb instead of deleting \ - Check for dependent projects before deletion

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-namespace-delete
destructive_patterns.description: circleci namespace delete removes an orb namespace.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a namespace removes all orbs within that namespace from the registry. \ This is a cascading deletion that affects every orb published under this namespace. \ All pipelines using any orb from this namespace will fail.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - circleci namespace list: Review namespaces first \ - circleci orb list: Inventory orbs in namespace \ - Delete individual orbs instead if needed

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-pipeline-delete
destructive_patterns.description: circleci pipeline delete removes pipeline history.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting pipeline history removes records of past builds, including logs, artifacts, \ and test results. This affects audit trails and debugging capabilities. The history \ cannot be recovered once deleted.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - circleci pipeline list: Review pipelines before deletion \ - Export logs and artifacts before deletion \ - Consider archiving rather than deleting

destructive_patterns.name: circleci-api-delete-envvar
destructive_patterns.description: curl DELETE against CircleCI envvar endpoints removes environment variables.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Making DELETE requests to CircleCI environment variable endpoints removes variables \ from projects. Pipelines depending on these variables will fail on next run. \ Variable values cannot be recovered after deletion.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - GET request first: Review variable exists \ - Update variable value instead of deleting \ - Use circleci CLI for safer operations
